name: search-ranking
title: Ranking: full-text search against grep

conditions.queries: 150, each labelled with the documents that answer it
conditions.grep: ripgrep counts per term, ranked by terms matched then hits

summary: Whether SQLite FTS5 with BM25 ranking, which ctx search uses, finds the right documents more often than ranked grep, the method an agent falls back on without it.
bar: BM25 ahead of grep on recall at 10 and nDCG at 10
baseline: ranked grep over the same files, which is how an agent searches without ctx
meaning: The ranking ctx uses finds about 57% of the labelled documents in its top 10, against 37% for grep. It is a clear win over grep and still misses a lot; no target for the absolute score has been set.
